subject: Operations
title: Core Competence Theory
description: A micro-lesson that makes Core Competence Theory usable.

hook.text: Honda makes cars, motorcycles, lawnmowers, and robots. The common thread? Engine and motor tech is its core competence.

buildup.text: Prahalad and Hamel defined core competence as a bundle of skills that provides access to a wide variety of markets.

discovery.text: A core competence is hard to imitate, provides customer value, and opens doors to multiple products and markets.

twist.text: Companies that outsource their core competence thinking it's just a cost center often can't rebuild it later.

climax.text: Amazon identified logistics as a core competence and invested billions. Now it sells logistics as a service to others.

punchline.text: Know your core. Protect it. Build on it.

quiz.question: What makes a capability a core competence?
options: It's hard to imitate and provides customer value
